name: Ahmad Iskandar
bio:
Ahmad Iskandar's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While pursuing his engineering degree at the University of Malaya, he volunteered at a local go-kart track, quickly discovering his passion for the technical intricacies of racing. He transitioned from karting to Formula Ford, working tirelessly to understand vehicle dynamics and performance optimization.

Prior to joining Hitech Development, Ahmad spent a decade honing his skills at Proton Motorsports, contributing to their rally program and later leading a team focused on developing performance road cars. He believes in a data-driven approach to operations, emphasizing clear communication and collaboration between departments. His pragmatic leadership style focuses on identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions to maximize efficiency and minimize risk.

What distinguishes Ahmad is his ability to blend technical expertise with strong management skills. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his knack for finding innovative solutions to complex operational challenges. He's determined to elevate Hitech Development to new heights.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height, with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every day with a strong cup of kopi O.
